facts.claim: The gateway reaches the extension daemon through github.com/xibodev/llmgw-core/extension, which go.mod already requires at v1.2.0, instead of its own HTTP client. Runtime.extensionClient builds one extension.Client from LLMGW_EXTENSION_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:18888) and LLMGW_EXTENSION_SECRET and shares it until either changes. The vertical's provider is extension.NewProvider with the same five surfaces, and refresh, OAuthDriver, ListModelsWithError and Synthesize all use the shared client.

Only the four collected files under go/internal/providers change. go.mod and go.sum are unchanged, and no file of the CLI, the version and build identity, the /health route (go/internal/api/server.go) or the /v1/models handler (go/internal/api/models.go) changes.

evidence.source: changed_paths of source primary; git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD

facts.claim: Behaviour that comes with core's client, for extension-served requests only. Streams have no total timeout (they were cut at 180 s), while invoke keeps a 180 s default deadline. Listing, refresh and sign-in steps get a 30 s default deadline when the caller sets none. Daemon error text is bounded to one line and classified by status, and redirects are not followed.

extension_vertical_test.go drives the vertical, the facade's ListModelsWithError and Synthesize, and Runtime.OAuthDriver against an httptest daemon that checks the shared secret. It covers invoke, streams with a skipped keepalive, models, refresh, bounded status-classified errors, OAuth start, poll and exchange, and the reuse and rebuilding of the shared client.

On head f6c7f68, CI's go build / vet / test, console lint / test / dist and deterministic Docker acceptance jobs pass. The deterministic acceptance boots the gateway container on a clean state. The workflow / container validation job fails only with REVIEW_STALE, which this review addresses.

conclusion.summary: The gateway reaches the extension daemon through llmgw-core's extension client instead of its own copy. No dependency, CLI, health or model-list code changes, the extension paths are tested against a fake daemon, and CI's build, test and deterministic acceptance jobs pass. Release identity, health and the public model list are therefore unchanged.
